title: Hermanus First Friday Art Walk
summary: Every first Friday of the month art galleries remain open until 8pm for a unique experience to “ArtWalk our Town”.
description:
Art in Hermanus is one of the jewels in the crown of our town along with wine, food, adventure and hospitality.
The wealth of unique art in our 26 galleries can be experienced by visitors on any day of the year but every first Friday of the month art galleries remain open until 8pm for a unique experience to “ArtWalk our Town”
Stroll through the village, and enjoy the impressive range of fine art, sculpture, ceramics, photography and jewellery on display.
Collect your ArtWalk map from any of the 26 galleries!
profile: On the first Friday of every month the 26 art galleries of Hermanus stay open until 8pm for an evening art walk through the village. Visitors collect an ArtWalk map from any gallery and stroll between them to see fine art, sculpture, ceramics, photography and jewellery. It suits art lovers and anyone in Hermanus on a first Friday evening.

title: Stanford Saturday Morning Market
summary: Stanford boasts its own unique Saturday Morning Market along Queen Victoria Street from 09h00–12h00.
description:
Stanford boasts its own unique Saturday Morning Market along Queen Victoria Street from 09h00–12h00.

Fresh produce from local farmers and local crafts are offered, as well as delicious homemade and home-baked goodies made from the heart! There are also old treasures waiting to be found and given a new lease on life.
profile: A Saturday morning market along Queen Victoria Street in Stanford, from 09:00 to 12:00 every week. Visitors buy fresh produce from local farmers, local crafts, homemade and home-baked goods, and hunt for old treasures. It suits anyone in Stanford on a Saturday morning looking for local food and finds.

title: Stanford Sunset Market
summary: Stanford is the place to be on the last Friday of every month from 18h00–20h00 at the Old Village Green, except during June, July and August.
description:
Stanford is the place to be on the last Friday of every month from 18h00–20h00 at the Old Village Green, except during June, July and August.

This market is reminiscent of the old days when farmers and traders used to gather and display their goods for sale on market day. Visit the market for exceptional homemade food, live music and real village hospitality, where locals and visitors mingle after the sun has long set.
profile: An evening market on the Old Village Green in Stanford on the last Friday of every month from 18:00 to 20:00, except in June, July and August. Visitors eat homemade food, listen to live music and mingle with locals in a village setting. It suits anyone in Stanford on a last-Friday evening.
